cases.name: Ana Maria Del Águila Córdova
cases.about:
Her Go Fund Me said: "To those who knew Ana Maria, she will be remembered and cherished as a vibrant spirit. With her unwavering enthusiasm and love, she gained the admiration from her colleagues, friends, and family alike. This is thanks to a blend of warmth, dedication, and unwavering work ethic that she gave out to the world.”

Her obituary said: "Today, I want to say goodbye with deep love and a heavy heart. Thank you for every moment, every memory, and every part of your life that you shared with us. Although you are no longer physically here, you will live on forever in our hearts. We will miss you deeply, but we will also remember you with love, affection, and a smile. Rest in peace. Watch over us from heaven."

cases.narrative: She was reportedly stabbed to death while taking out the trash at a Wendy's restaurant in Island Park, where she worked the late shift. He allegedly had stabbed his roommate Eddy Raquel Hernandez Castillo to death 3 hours earlier.
